news.title:
Piramal Finance saw Q4 FY26 NIM rise 14bps YoY and 23bps QoQ to 6.5%. GNPA improved 32bps QoQ to 2.3%.
Total AUM crossed ₹1 lakh Cr, up 25% YoY, with growth AUM up 33% YoY. Credit ratings upgraded to AA and BB.
news.summary:
Piramal Finance saw Q4 FY26 NIM rise 14bps YoY and 23bps QoQ to 6.5%. GNPA improved 32bps QoQ to 2.3%.
Total AUM crossed ₹1 lakh Cr, up 25% YoY, with growth AUM up 33% YoY. Credit ratings upgraded to AA and BB.

news.title:
Jefferies maintains Hold on Piramal Finance with ₹1,940 target, citing Q4 adjusted loss from legacy provisions despite AUM and NIM growth.
FY26–28 outlook positive with retail AUM growth, lower costs, and better opex, but upside capped by ~1.4x FY27 P/B and modest RoA/RoE.
